text: This is Slana. The on-chain arena on Solana.
Buy a ticket, and drop into a live round.
Eat smaller players... Take what they carry... and grow.
Everyone still standing at the bell gets paid.
Bots carry no value. But when a bot eats you, your tokens spill as loot.
Four arenas, open to everyone. From one thousand to two hundred fifty thousand Slana.
Join a round that's already running. Eaten? Buy back in, same fee.
One flat fee: five percent of profit. Floor loot left at the bell is burned.
Slana... Eat... Grow... Last the round.
